title: Madai
summary: Son of Japheth (Gen 10:2); ancestor of the Medes. CFAH-5 discusses a "Median Dynasty of Babylon" (AP-39) that it connects to Madai.
description: Son of Japheth (Gen 10:2); ancestor of the Medes. CFAH-5 discusses a "Median Dynasty of Babylon" (AP-39) that it connects to Madai. Josephus (Antiquities I.6.1, Whiston): "from Madai came the Madeans, who are called Medes, by the Greeks"
